title: Finite-torsion proper base change
statement:
Let

$$
 \begin{array}{ccc}
 X'&\xrightarrow{g'}&X\\
 f'\downarrow&&\downarrow f\\
 Y'&\xrightarrow{g}&Y
 \end{array}
$$

be cartesian [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square] with $f$ proper. For every
torsion sheaf $F$ on $X_{\Et}$,

$$
 \Ex_{\square,F}:g^{-1}Rf_*F
 \xrightarrow{\sim}Rf'_*g'^{-1}F
$$

is an isomorphism in $\Dplus(Y'_{\Et})$, where $\Ex_{\square,F}$ is the
derived exchange morphism [def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange].

proof.text: Put $K=F[0]$, represented by the complex with $F$ in degree $0$, zero objects in all other degrees, and zero differentials. Computing $\Ker d^i/\Im d^{i-1}$ gives $\mathcal H^0(K)=F$ and $\mathcal H^i(K)=0$ for $i\ne0$. Thus $K\in\Dplus(X_{\Et})$ with lower bound $0$ by [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Its cohomology sheaves are torsion: $F$ is torsion by hypothesis and every local section of the zero sheaf is killed by $1$, by [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves].

source.place: Detailed form, Proof: specialization K=F[0]; Stacks 0DDE (lemma-proper-base-change) specialized to degree zero

proof.text: The square is cartesian and $f$ is proper by the hypotheses of the item; Step 1 supplies a bounded-below complex with torsion cohomology. Apply [thm-weil-pbc-bounded-below] to this same square and $K=F[0]$. It gives that $\Ex_{\square,F[0]}:g^{-1}Rf_*F[0]\to Rf'_*g'^{-1}F[0]$ is an isomorphism in $\Dplus(Y'_{\Et})$, with no restriction on $g$.

The notation $Rf_*F$ in the item means the derived direct image of the sheaf placed in degree $0$. By [def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange], the morphism denoted $\Ex_{\square,F}$ is the component at that object of the very same transformation $\Ex_\square:g^{-1}Rf_*\to Rf'_*g'^{-1}$. Therefore $\Ex_{\square,F}=\Ex_{\square,F[0]}$; the isomorphism of Step 2 is precisely the asserted morphism, rather than an unspecified isomorphism between its endpoints.

blueprint_sketch.statement:
Let

$$
\begin{CD}
X'@>{g'}>>X\\
@V{f'}VV @VV{f}V\\
Y'@>{g}>>Y
\end{CD}
$$

be Cartesian with $f$ proper. For every torsion sheaf $F$ on
$X_{\mathrm{et}}$, the canonical exchange map

$$
g^{-1}Rf_*F\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf'_*g'^{-1}F
$$

is an isomorphism. These isomorphisms are natural in $F$, equal the identity
for identity squares, and commute with horizontal and vertical pasting.
blueprint_sketch.proof:
The torsion assembly proves the isomorphism in every cohomological degree for
the map constructed in S0. A morphism in $D^+$ is an isomorphism exactly when
all its cohomology sheaf maps are isomorphisms. Naturality, identity, and
pasting are the corresponding S0 coherence equations and survive each
devissage step. This is the expanded endpoint whose source locator is Tag
`095T`; that tag is not used as a proof leaf.
